scope: Mechanical eligibility for independently reviewing the fixed local format pilot; semantic criteria unchanged
semantic_invariants: Existing adoption-lock, full-source and selected-evidence support, sufficiency, natural Korean, all thresholds, sources, questions, budgets and scope notes remain unchanged.

eligibility.include: Include EVERY unique, complete, sealed, integrity-verified parsed summary or QA artifact actually emitted by the fixed runner for a fixed source/question slot after its existing strict parser accepted an EOS-complete generation.
eligibility.invariant_to: Later model self-review, operational outcome, apparent quality, acceptance, latency, and output length are not additional selection filters. Existing parser limits remain unchanged.
eligibility.QA_abstention: Include abstention artifacts if emitted by that existing parser; eligibility does not imply semantic sufficiency.
eligibility.exclude: Raw-only, non-EOS, strict-parser-rejected, missing, partially persisted or integrity-unverified artifacts are not semantic packets. Never repair, reparse raw, truncate, merge or regenerate to manufacture eligibility.
eligibility.custody: Technical custodian must first verify sealed bytes, original parsed-artifact hash, fixed runner registration, fixed source/question/evidence linkage and completion/parser provenance. Sealing and integrity success do not imply run or cleanup success.
eligibility.failed_execution: A complete eligible parsed artifact followed by resource, cleanup or another operational failure remains included for diagnostic model-content judgment only. Run and service acceptance stay failed.

mechanical_clarifications.slot: One fixed task kind plus source and, for QA, fixed question identity; no source or question replacement.
mechanical_clarifications.unique: Byte-identical aliases count as one only when custody proves the same original artifact provenance. Distinct candidates or unresolved duplicate provenance withhold the whole affected slot; never choose the better-looking candidate.
mechanical_clarifications.partial: Partial means incomplete persistence or integrity, never semantically incomplete content. Semantically weak but structurally eligible content remains included.
mechanical_clarifications.absence: Missing artifact does not prove unexecuted. Use unexecuted only when provenance establishes no execution; otherwise preserve no-output or unresolved status.

packet.contents: Opaque item IDs, task kind, original parsed output content and exact prebound source/question/evidence mappings only.
packet.projection: Copy the parsed content subtree without changing strings, numbers, ordering of arrays, citations or abstention fields. A mechanical projection may omit metadata; it must not edit or reconstruct content. Custodian retains the original artifact bytes/hash and the projection provenance.
packet.withheld: No model self-review, operational or structural disposition, slot-ledger reasons, performance, model identity or new identity mapping before individual judgment lock.
packet.unavoidable_exposure: Packet item count and intrinsic output content may reveal availability or abstention; complete blinding is not claimed.

ledger.owner: Parent or technical custodian retains all eight fixed slots and complete provenance.
ledger.separate: Keep execution/no-output, structural rejection, integrity withholding, model self-review disposition and independent semantic judgment distinct.
ledger.unjudged: Excluded or absent slots remain not semantically judged with their mechanical reason. Never report them as semantic 0 percent or silently reduce summary4/QA4 denominators.
ledger.subset: Report eligible count and independently judged count separately from fixed denominators; no semantic rate is assigned to an empty judged set.

disclosure_order: Parent binds this exact addendum to the prospective execution companion before dispatch.
Parent separately assigns all eligible anonymous output-only items after custody.
Judge locks individual judgments under existing criteria, without the full slot ledger, self-review, performance or identity mapping.
Only after that lock may parent separately authorize those disclosures; no eligible items means zero semantic judgments, not a semantic failure rate.
